title: The Far Passage
author: Oscar Voss
blurb: Mara Okafor, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, has spent twenty years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must cross the range ahead of the snows before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
